articles.title: The institutional edge: moomoo targets Wall Street-grade trading tools for retail crypto investors
articles.snippet: The brokerage giant says the future of investing won’t be defined by asset access alone but by the quality of tools investors get.

articles.title: SEC sues Texas man over $12.3 million alleged crypto scheme built on fake AI trading bots
articles.snippet: Fuller allegedly diverted $6.2 million for personal use and $5.5M for Ponzi-like payments; only 3% of funds went to crypto trading.

articles.title: When the market is bad, we build: Inside Binance’s bold 2030 master plan
articles.snippet: Established crypto firms will merge with traditional finance, but neither Wall Street bankers nor corporate giants will take over the crypto industry, said Binance’s Head of VIP and Institutional, Catherine Chen.

articles.title: Hyperliquid could become a ‘financial services juggernaut’ as DeFi expands, says Grayscale
articles.snippet: The digital asset manager says Hyperliquid is emerging as a blockchain-based financial infrastructure platform with the potential to expand beyond crypto trading and challenge parts of traditional derivatives and exchange markets.

articles.title: U.S. regulator says 24/7 trading is great for crypto, may not be fit for other sectors
articles.snippet: As the CFTC issued landmark approvals for crypto perpetual futures contracts, it explained in a related advisory that round-the-clock activity isn't right for all.
